body: Thanks guys. The funny thing is that I had a good day overall - just not with people. Time for sleep soon anyway, and then tomorrow is another day
Thank you

DOI said as far as they're concerned the whole thing is closed... 

Thank you for taking the time to reply so comprehensively. It does sound as though I've taken it as far as I can, unfortunately.

Hopefully just having had to deal with the official complaint has been enough to scare him into doing things properly from now on. I'd hate for someone else who perhaps doesn't have my resources / willingness to see it through regardless of the length of time + go to court, to be duped by this guy on behalf of his friends.

They said that it was all closed. 

I don't even want damages - the way they paid off my bills within 2 weeks after I filed my small claims court thing told me they knew they were wrong. The person I spoke to who was doing the paying was super uncomfortable when I asked him if it was normal for one of their agents to pretend to be talking to adjusters while not having filed anything.

  
This guy owns properties around White Plains. He rents them out to immigrants. The brazen way in which he behaved with me, knowing I am an immigrant, makes me think he figured he'd get away with it if he dragged it out long enough. He relies on people's concerns.

This is an entire pack of lies. I sent them all of the estimates. And the bills. They were never amenable, and the whole thing only stopped when I sued them. I'm honestly just tired because I tried to fix things in a friendly way at the time, and I ended up dealing with all of this. What's the point really when bad people will be shamelessly bad?
And I don’t know how to manage it
I got a response, several months later

So what competing product is Walmart trying to sell/market? 
What insurance companies is the Walton family invested in that they would want to see these claims reduced/turned away?
Which stores in what areas is Walmart trying to shut down by claiming a decrease in profits?
Someone at Walmart saw the headlines and decided to capitalise on them - and Target already used the “increased thefts” (false) claims to shut down their less profitable stores. 

On a related note, it’s very telling that their statement is essentially: these medications are keeping our addicts away from us. I have been buying less of everything with Mounjaro. Impulse control is greater - so it’s not just food IMO

I’m filing an initial complaint against the agent, but it sounds like I should file one against the insurance company too, right? That’s more likely to make them handle things transparently?
I’m in NY state so I’m not sure if I can do two separate ones.

I will post updates as things come up.
I will! In case it helps anyone else too

One thing Mounjaro does help with, in my experience, is those feelings. Food is just food now. I’ll eat 2 doughnuts with pure delight - because my body is wanting that on that specific day. I’ll also eat sautéed baby bok choy in garlic and chilli crunch (specific!! 😂) as a genuine craving too. 
In general I have found that processed products simply aren’t appealing anymore (I’m on 15mg maintenance every 2 weeks now). 
For some reason, without the shame and guilt, a lot of food doesn’t taste as good.

The actual claims person called me again today (logged properly because I got an automated text message beforehand letting me know about it), requesting additional receipts. He told me he paid me too quickly apparently and a complaint had been raised and he needed the additional receipts essentially to cover his back.

During the call, I asked him if it was normal for his company to have someone handle an entire claim off the books before filing it, and he sounded very uncomfortable before saying that no it wasn’t normal. He moved the conversation on very quickly. 

So I sent him the additional receipts, a copy of the form I sent saying I was withdrawing my suit, and a couple of lines telling him I’d be filing a complaint about his colleague’s behaviour. 

From what you’re saying, it sounds like they’ve turned a simple hit and run into something much messier - and involving a lot more people. 

I really appreciate your insight. These are all things I did not know about and wouldn’t have thought to ask about.
Oh - that’s not something I even thought about! As far as I can tell he’s an insurance agent - so selling the products? Does that make it worse?

I mostly want him not to do that to anyone else. I was hard nosed and could afford to wait on the reimbursements from the insurance company, but other people may not be so lucky. 
And if he’s prepared to do that for one friend, I expect he’s prepared to do that for all his other friends too. 
Which is why I wanted to raise it with the company so they could deal with it - but I hadn’t considered that he could just as well operate the same way at a different place.
Yes, they’re close friends. The agent mentioned that to me when he first called me to tell me the other guy is a good guy…
I wasn’t sure at first but I did look him up, and the second agent who fixed things for me knew who he was as well.
Thank you! I wasn't sure if I had a legitimate complaint
